mapper.select: select sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, stock, warn_stock from biz_product_sku where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and warn_stock > 0 and stock <= warn_stock order by sku_id
select sku_id from biz_stock_alert where status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into biz_stock_alert (sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, stock, warn_stock, status, triggered_time, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{stock}, #{warnStock}, '0', now(), 'system', now(), 'Quartz低库存预警')
mapper.update: update biz_stock_alert set status = '1', resolved_time = now(), update_by = 'system', update_time = now() where sku_id = #{skuId} and status = '0'
